gr.islandsHint: On a generated atlas the islands are cut for packing, not for meaning.
gr.warnColour: No material carries a base colour texture, so colour cannot say anything the material does not.
gr.warnManifold: {n} non-manifold edges: folds are approximate there.
gr.needsApp: Segmentation needs the application, not the browser
gr.mismatch: The mesh sent has {a} triangles and the engine read {b}: the result would be shifted.
gr.splitNothing: Nothing to split: no mesh carries groups
gr.mapHint: Hard edges to select a part by its colour, softened to use it as a blend mask.
gr.mapNothing: Nothing to draw: the model has no UVs
gr.mapOverlap: {n} groups share UV space with others and do not appear separately: a map cannot give the same texels two colours. Use the split for those.
gr.nnHint: One label per triangle, produced by PartField, P3-SAM or SAMesh. It becomes a barrier: the split will never join two parts it separates, and everything else still applies on top.
